added: Automatically resume incomplete chapter downloads after temporary HTTP 503 service-unavailable failures, with bounded 1/2/5-minute delays.
fixed: Avoid leaving an unfinished chapter in an error state after all immediate HTTP 503 attempts are exhausted.
improved: Keep the current chapter first in the queue during a transient server outage, instead of skipping ahead to the next chapter.
Honor the server's Retry-After delay when present and retain existing automatic WorkManager recovery across app restarts.
Preserve partial chapter pages, one-page-at-a-time downloads, and the existing safe HTTP 429 recovery behavior.
